---
title: Build guide
description: Build a Mosaic from an off-the-shelf display board, a small carrier PCB and a 3D-printed enclosure.
---

Mosaic is built from an off-the-shelf display board, a small carrier PCB, a few modules and a 3D-printed enclosure.

This guide is being written. Until then, the [carrier PCB](https://github.com/mosaic-device/mosaic/tree/main/hardware/pcb) and [firmware](https://github.com/mosaic-device/mosaic/tree/main/firmware) READMEs cover the board and flashing.
